subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker until both the Google thinking sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios auth-stack paths are proven fixed, or should the auth-stack crash be split into a separate canonical issue?
rationale: Two related but distinct failure paths are evidenced by current source and issue comments, and active PRs cover only parts of the provider/auth surface.

options.title: Keep one canonical issue
options.body: Track both sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios proof here until released behavior no longer crashes.

options.title: Split auth-stack work
options.body: Close only the sanitizer slice after it lands and move the ADC/gaxios dependency crash to a separate canonical issue.

options.title: Accept sanitizer-only closure
options.body: Close after the sanitizer PR lands even if native Vertex ADC proof remains pending, relying on follow-up reports for the auth stack.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical issue
recommendation.body: Track both sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios proof here until released behavior no longer crashes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest current owner signal for the Google thinking wrapper boundary that must be resolved or intentionally scoped.
